result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is visually broken: cards have inconsistent image heights and vertical alignment, so titles and delivery prices sit on different baselines. Text in the third card is hard-clipped without an ellipsis, and there are minor inconsistencies in card imagery styling and favorite-icon treatment.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the three cards are not aligned: the first card's image is shorter and starts higher, the second card's image is taller and pushed down, so the restaurant names ('Green Bowl Poké', 'Smash Bros Burgers', 'Trattoria Piccol…') and the delivery prices sit at three different vertical positions. The time badges are also at different heights.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards a fixed, equal image aspect ratio/height and align items to the top of the row (align-items: flex-start with uniform card height) so titles, prices and badges line up.

issues.description: The third card's title 'Trattoria Piccol' is hard-cut at the screen edge with no ellipsis, making the name unreadable and looking like broken text rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with a single-line clamp inside the card width, and ensure the carousel peeks the next card by a consistent amount so titles are never sliced mid-character.

issues.description: Card imagery is inconsistent: the first card uses a very light grey/placeholder-looking background while the other cards use dark photographic backgrounds, which makes the first card read as a missing image.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image treatment (same overlay/gradient and background tone) or use real photography for all cards so none look like an unloaded placeholder.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons in 'Popular right now' are styled differently: the first card has an outline heart with no background, while the second sits on a dark circular chip.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite button component (same size, background scrim and icon weight) across all cards for legibility on both light and dark images.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off abruptly by the bottom tab bar with no visible fade or bottom padding, so it looks clipped rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so the last card can fully scroll into view.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped mid-chip at the right edge with no affordance indicating it scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent trailing peek/padding or a subtle gradient fade to signal horizontal scrollability.
